title: Tech Note: Processing Write Pro documents (faceless)
author: Vance Villanueva, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The core problem (batch/backend generation of documents with embedded expressions, without a form UI) is still a common need and 4D Write Pro remains the current document engine; the specific workaround shown here (encapsulating expressions inside an EVALUATION_METHOD wrapper processed via PROCESS 4D TAGS) reflects an early-4D-Write-Pro-era limitation that later 4D Write Pro versions have addressed more directly with native faceless/offscreen document object handling.
related_updates: 4D Write Pro has since gained more native, documented support for headless/backend document manipulation, reducing the need for the EVALUATION_METHOD/PROCESS_EXPRESSIONS workaround
4D Write (classic) is fully retired in 64-bit 4D; any migration guidance about converting legacy 4D Write documents is now purely historical
PROCESS 4D TAGS and expression evaluation concepts remain valid 4D language features
